source: Bonuses and talent names from the Division Fandom gear-set table, plus the Core Strength, Tipping Scales, Refactor, Ortiz: Reficere, Virtuoso, and Ember Engine pages. Talent text is the wiki summary, not a rewritten description. Measured Assembly follows the Ubisoft Crossroads notes, checked against ProtoTrack and shd.gg. Concentrated Company follows ProtoTrack, the Fandom set page, and shd.gg.

items.name: Aces & Eights
items.talentText: DEAD MANS HAND: draw cards on rifle hits and headshots. After 5 cards, amp the next 1-4 shots, based on the 5 card hand drawn.
items.backpackText: Amps 1 extra shot by 30%.
items.chestText: Amp is increased from 30% to 50%.

items.name: Aegis
items.talentText: STOIC: Get 3% dmg resistance per enemy targeting you. Multiplied by 1.X, X = team size.
items.backpackText: Increases Stoic dmg Resistance to 4%.
items.chestText: Enemies targeting your Decoy also count towards the Stoic dmg Resistance Bonus.

items.name: Breaking Point
items.talentText: ON POINT: Reloading after Rifle or MMR hits grants Handling and Damage per stack, for 10 seconds
items.backpackText: Increases On Point Weapon dmg bonus from 4% to 6%.
items.chestText: Increase On Point bonuses timer from 10s to 15s.

items.name: Cavalier
items.talentText: CHARGING - Reduce incoming skill damage per second out of cover, up to 50%. CHARGED: At max (10s), become immune to movement CC, and share skill DR and all Hazard Protection with all allies. Lasts 10 seconds.
items.backpackText: Charging gives 10% protection per second.
items.chestText: Increases Charging max incoming dmg protection to 70%.

items.name: Eclipse Protocol
items.talentText: INDIRECT TRANSMISSION: Status effects spread on kill to ALL enemies within 10m, and refresh 50% of their duration.
items.backpackText: Amplifies all dmg you deal to status affected targets by 30%.
items.chestText: Increases Indirect Transmission range from 10m to 15m and refresh percentage from 50% to 75%.

items.name: Foundry Bulwark
items.talentText: MAKESHIFT REPAIRS: Whenever you or your shield take damage, 20% of that amount is repaired to both over 15s.
items.backpackText: Increases Makeshift Repairs from 20% to 30%.
items.chestText: Increases Makeshift Repairs speed from 15s to 10s.

items.name: Future Initiative
items.talentText: GROUND CONTROL: At full armor, entire team gains 15% skill dmg and 15% weapon dmg. 60% of ally healing is matched.
items.backpackText: Increases Ground Control proximity repair from 60% to 120%.
items.chestText: Increases Ground Control dmg bonus from +15% to +25%.

items.name: Hard Wired
items.talentText: FEEDBACK LOOP: Using or canceling a skill refunds 30s skill cooldown to your other skill. Can occur once per 20s.
items.backpackText: Increases Feedback Loop skill dmg and repair bonus from +10% to +25%.
items.chestText: Decreases Feedback Loop cooldown from 20s to 10s.

items.name: Heartbreaker
items.talentText: HEARTSTOPPER: Headshots pulse for 5s. Shots against pulsed enemies grant 1% bonus armor and 1% Wep dmg, up to 50. Decays 2 per second
items.backpackText: Increases total bonus armor gained per stack of Heartbreaker from 1% to 2%.
items.chestText: Increases max stacks for Heartstopper from 50 to 100.

items.name: Hotshot
items.talentText: HEADACHE: 1st HeadShot: 20% damage to next headshot. 2nd HS: gives 10% repair, or 10% bonus armor, max 50%. 3rd HS: refills the mag. 4th+ HS: grants all 3. Missing resets the sequence.
items.backpackText: Agents can miss a headshot before resetting the cycle.
items.chestText: Increases bonus Armor from 50% to 100%.

items.name: Hunter's Fury
items.bonus3: +20% Armor on kill · +50% Health on kill
items.talentText: APEX PREDATOR: Nearby enemies (15m) are debuffed by 20%. Killing these debuffed enemies with a weapon disorients within 5m, and amps weapon dmg by 5%, up to 25%, for 10s.
items.backpackText: Increases the radius of disorient on Apex Predator kills from 5m to 10m.
items.chestText: Increases the duration of Apex Predator stacks from 10s to 30s.

items.name: Negotiator's Dilemma
items.talentText: HOSTILE NEGOTIATIONS: Critical hits mark up to 3 enemies for 20s. When you critically hit a marked enemy, share 60% of the damage to other marks. Gain +2% critical hit damage poer marked enemy tha dies, stacking up to 20 times while in combat.
items.backpackText: Increases Hostile Negotiations dmg to additional marked enemies from 60% to 100%.
items.chestText: Increases Hostile Negotiations mark count from 3 to 5.

items.name: Ongoing Directive
items.talentText: RULES OF ENGAGEMENT: Mark any status affected enemy with a shot. Kills/assists against a marked enemy grants 1 mag of HP Ammo (bleed) for your active weapon, and half a clip to all allies. Mark lasts for 10 seconds.
items.backpackText: Increases the duration of your bleed status effects by 50% and all bleed dmg done by 100%.
items.chestText: Increases Hollow-Point Ammo dmg to 50%, for you only.

items.name: Ortiz: Exuro
items.talentText: ORTIZ INCINERATOR TURRET PROTOTYPE: Flame turret spins 360°, and you are immune to its fire. Explodes when disabled.
items.backpackText: +25% Weapon dmg to enemies ignited by the Flame Turret. +25% Flame Turret Range.
items.chestText: Enemies set on fire by the Flame Turret ignite other enemies within 2m.

items.name: Rigger
items.talentText: TEND AND BEFRIEND: Interacting with deployed skills grants the skill 25% damage for 10s. Cannot be refreshed. Interactions include: Using/Deploying the Skill, changing the Skills target, Healing the Skill.
items.backpackText: Canceling your skills will reset their cooldown.
items.chestText: Increase the dmg buff from 25% to 50%.

items.name: Striker's Battlegear
items.talentText: STRIKERS GAMBLE: Weapon hits increase damage, up to 100 stacks (65%). [0-50]: 1 stack decay per second. [51-100]: 2 stack decay per second.
items.backpackText: Increases total weapon dmg gained per stack of Striker’s Gamble from 0.65% to 1%.
items.chestText: Max stacks increased to 200. Lose 3 stacks per second between 100 and 200.

items.name: System Corruption
items.talentText: HACKSTEP PROTOCOL: Replaces armor kits with an instant, infinite-use ability on a 20s cooldown, that repairs 20% armor, grants 50% bonus armor and hides your nameplate for 5s. Increases total weapon damage by 1% per 5% bonus armor gained, up to 20%.
items.backpackText: Increases Hackstep Protocol bonus armor from 50% to 100%.
items.chestText: Decreases Hackstep Protocol cooldown from 20s to 15s.

items.name: Tip of the Spear
items.talentText: AGGRESSIVE RECON: Signature Weapon kills give +15% Signature Weapon Damage for 10s and +25% Reload Speed for the next reload of the weapon, not stacking. Gain Signature Weapon Ammo every 60s.
items.backpackText: +50% Weapon dmg for 15s after fully depleting the Signature Weapon of ammo. Doubles the amount of ammo generated by Aggressive Recon.
items.chestText: Increase Aggressive Recon Signature Weapon dmg bonus from 15% to 30%. Every 3rd Signature Weapon kill generates Signature Weapon ammo.

items.name: True Patriot
items.talentText: RED, WHITE, AND BLUE: Every 2s, enemies you shoot receive a stacking color debuff. Red - enemy takes 8% amped damage. White - Shooting this enemy repairs 2% armor, once per second. Blue - Enemy deals 8% reduced damage. FULL FLAG: Enemies that die by all 3 debuffs, dealing their total health and armor as damage. (Explosion damage reduced on Named enemy deaths.)
items.backpackText: Increases debuff strength. Red - 8% to 12%. White - 2% to 3%. Blue - 8% to 12%.
items.chestText: RED, WHITE, AND BLUE cycles every 1.5s, down from 2s

items.name: Umbra Initiative
items.talentText: FROM THE SHADOWS: While in cover, gain crit damage and rpm over 5s, up to 50%/15%, which applies out of cover and decays slowly. While out of cover and in combat, gain future armor regen over 5s, up to 40%. Stacks consume at the same rate in cover, repairing armor.
items.backpackText: Doubles the armor regen buff
items.chestText: Doubles the crit dmg and rpm buff

items.name: Core Strength
items.bonus3: 5% Weapon Damage, 5% Total Armor, 5% Skill Efficiency
items.talentText: For each Core on your Gear Pieces, receive 40% of the other two Cores' bonuses. Skill Tiers count at 15% Skill Efficiency when these bonuses are applied. All pieces apart from the Backpack feature random Cores.
items.backpackText: This Talent does not change Core Exercise. This Backpack features three Core Attributes.
items.chestText: Increase Core Exercise from 40% to 75% of the other Cores' bonuses.

items.name: Tipping Scales
items.talentText: Shooting builds stacks to a max of 50. Each stack provides +0.5% Weapon Handling and +5% Critical Hit Damage. Lose 6 stacks per second while not shooting. No stacks are lost if an enemy is Suppressed.
items.backpackText: Increase Throttle Control Critical Hit Damage per stack from 5% to 8%.
items.chestText: Increase Throttle Control maximum stacks from 50 to 75.

items.name: Refactor
items.talentText: Receive repairs of 10% of the damage dealt by your Skills. Allies receive repairs of 20% of that damage. PvP: 5% and 10%.
items.chestText: Increase Return to Sender repairs from 10% to 25% and from 20% to 35%.
items.backpackText: While at full Armor, Return to Sender repairs provide Bonus Armor, up to 80% of your Total Armor. Does not apply to allies.

items.name: Ortiz: Reficere
items.talentText: Healing Skills' Duration and Range are decreased by 90%, but Healing Efficiency is increased by 150%. Healing an ally grants them 30% Hazard Protection for 10s. Cooldown per ally: 10s.
items.backpackText: Reduces the Range and Duration reduction from 90% to 25%.
items.chestText: Increases the Healing Efficiency bonus from 150% to 200%.

items.name: Virtuoso
items.talentText: A kill farther than 25m buffs shotguns, SMGs, and pistols by 40%, ARs and LMGs by 20%, and grants 25% bonus armor for 15s. A kill within 25m buffs MMRs and rifles by 40%, ARs and LMGs by 20%, and headshot damage by 30% for 15s. Four stacks from both ranges multiply all bonuses by 2.
items.backpackText: Symphony's doubled buff needs 3 stacks instead of 4.
items.chestText: Doubles Symphony weapon damage.

items.name: Ember Engine
items.talentText: Every Status Effect you apply has a 40% chance of also applying Burn. If the initial effect was Burn, the enemy takes +25% Burn Damage for that Burn.
items.chestText: Increase Spontaneous Combustion's chance to apply Burn to 60%.
items.backpackText: Increase the Burn Damage debuff duration of Spontaneous Combustion by 50%.

items.name: Measured Assembly
items.talentText: Receive +1 Skill Tier for each ally Agent that is within range of your Hive or Smart Cover. While at Skill Tier 6, having at least one ally Agent in the range of your Hive or Smart Cover for 4s will grant Overcharge for 15s. Cooldown: 40s. Mortars and enemy Skills that enter the range of your Hive or Smart Cover will be destroyed. Cooldown 10s. The cooldown is 20% faster for each ally Agent within the range of your Hive or Smart Cover.
items.chestText: Decrease the Overcharge cooldown from 40s to 25s.
items.backpackText: Decrease the cooldown for destroying Mortars or enemy Skills from 10s to 1s.

items.name: Concentrated Company
items.talentText: Shooting an enemy marks them for 10s. When a marked enemy dies, receive one stack of 3% Weapon Damage and 3% Critical Hit Damage for each ally or skill that contributed to killing that enemy, including yourself. Maximum stacks: 35. Stacks decay every 10s. Maximum number of marks: 4.
items.chestText: Increase the amount of marks that can be placed from 4 to 8.
items.backpackText: Increases the Weapon Damage bonus per stack from 3% to 6%.
